comments.text:
I'm 21 and had all major bank credit card except sbi, and through out my journey, beside your cibil score - bank see your past history (how old your cibil history is) and your relationship with bank. example when i was 19 kotak give me pre-approved credit card because of i maintain a good amount of balance in their bank and also i had idfc bank credit card which i got on fd based. and if u use a good amount of money on credit card and make bank believe you never gonna default. why don't they give you. 

my suggestion - 
1- apply to basic cards first (entry level), based on your income. 
2- don't even try to apply for multiple credit card or loan in a time frame. 

doesn't matter u got the card or not but on cilbil there will mark a inquiry for years, which banks always see. 
and this show as a hungry for loan. which no bank like.
